data.narrative:
Icarus is a seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Henry Kwan, whose background includes spacecraft and space robotics development at Orbital, a $935M NASA space habitat contract win, and prior work as a NASA flight sciences drone designer. The comparable universe consists of 10 private companies and 2 public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) in the same sector, with reference companies including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Valuation analysis relies on peer-median methodology applied to three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables. UFORCE trades at $1.0B (seed), Singularity at $400M (Series A), and NODA AI at $125M (Series A), establishing a median valuation of $400M with a range spanning $125M to $1.0B. This peer-median approach is the primary applicable triangulation method given data constraints at the seed stage.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $340M to $460M, centered on $400M. Key uncertainties include the limited sample size (three peers) and stage heterogeneity within the comp set, where two of three comparables are post-seed. Founder pedigree—particularly prior success at aerospace scale and government contracting—partially justifies positioning toward the higher end of peer ranges, though revenue traction and product-market validation remain unknown from available data.
